answer: A farm cannot share one proof across a hundred names, so its costs multiply while its reward stays single. One person, one seat, one toll paid: the rule holds because the price does. Before the stamp comes a toll of 44 credits, collected in coin before the name is written down, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. Nobody walks in twice on the same papers; Windbound steam boatman beacon charter sees to it, since a charter boatmen file after dock checks. The pulse is checked, not assumed. The velvet is on the docket. reef stays on the record.
